access_codes_used_consistency.name: access_codes_used_consistency
access_codes_used_consistency.value: ("access_codes"."is_used" = false AND "access_codes"."used_at" IS NULL) OR ("access_codes"."is_used" = true AND "access_codes"."used_at" IS NOT NULL)

access_codes_issued_consistency.name: access_codes_issued_consistency
access_codes_issued_consistency.value: ("access_codes"."is_issued" = false AND "access_codes"."issued_at" IS NULL) OR ("access_codes"."is_issued" = true AND "access_codes"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL)

access_codes_revoked_consistency.name: access_codes_revoked_consistency
access_codes_revoked_consistency.value: ("access_codes"."is_revoked" = false AND "access_codes"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("access_codes"."is_revoked" = true AND "access_codes"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

quiz_attempts_completed_consistency.name: quiz_attempts_completed_consistency
quiz_attempts_completed_consistency.value: ("quiz_attempts"."status"::text = 'in_progress' AND "quiz_attempts"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "quiz_attempts"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) OR ("quiz_attempts"."status"::text = 'completed' AND "quiz_attempts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "quiz_attempts"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) OR ("quiz_attempts"."status"::text = 'cancelled' AND "quiz_attempts"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "quiz_attempts"."completed_at" IS NULL)

quiz_attempts_participant_name_consisten.name: quiz_attempts_participant_name_consistency
quiz_attempts_participant_name_consisten.value: ("quiz_attempts"."participant_name" IS NULL AND "quiz_attempts"."participant_name_key" IS NULL) OR ("quiz_attempts"."participant_name" IS NOT NULL AND "quiz_attempts"."participant_name_key" IS NOT NULL)
